ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Culture（中世日本 - 文化）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Development prototype. Adds a candidate traditional floor seat (enza), with source-only eating-Job integration under development, and makes the AteWithoutTable mood effect neutral. Enza meal seating requires a compiled AMJ.Culture assembly that is not yet included. Not approved for gameplay release.
開発用試作。円座による床座の食事機能を開発中。現時点では食事処理用のコンパイル済みDLLを含まない。テーブルなし食事の心情補正は0。実機検証・公開は未実施。
